tha-ap434:1.1: Ekasaṅkhiya.] Vipassino bhagavato mahābodhimaho ahū / mahājanā samāgamma pūjenti bodhim uttamaṃ. // //
tha-ap434:2.1: Na hi taṃ orakaṃ maññe Buddhaseṭṭho bhavissati / yassāyam edisā bodhi pūjanīyā va satthuno. // //
tha-ap434:3.1: Tato saṅkhaṃ gahetvāna bodhirukkhaṃ upaṭṭhahaṃ / dhamento sabbadivasaṃ avandiṃ bodhim uttamaṃ. // //
tha-ap434:4.1: Āsannake kataṃ kammaṃ devalokaṃ a*pāpayiṃ* / kalebaraṃ me patitaṃ devaloke ramām' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap434:5.1: Saṭṭhituriyasahassāni tuṭṭhahaṭṭhapamoditā / sadā mayhaṃ upaṭṭhanti Buddhapūjāy' idam phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap434:6.1: Ekasattat' ime kappe rājā āsi Sudassano / cāturanto vijitāvī *jambūsaṇḍa*ssa issaro. // //
tha-ap434:7.1: Tato aṅgasatā turyā parivārenti maṃ sadā / anubhomi sakaṃ kammaṃ upaṭṭhānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap434:8.1: Yaṃ yaṃ yonūpapajjāmi devattaṃ atha mānusaṃ / mātukucchigatassāpi vajjare bheriyo sadā. // //
tha-ap434:9.1: Upaṭṭhahitvā *sambuddhaṃ* anubhotvāna sampadā / sivaṃ sukhemaṃ amataṃ patto 'mhi acalaṃ padaṃ. // //
tha-ap434:10.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap434:14.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ekasaṅkhiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
